test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On day one, with speed v, R covers a distance x, in t time. On the next day, he covers a distance 2.5x in 0.75t time. What is his speed the next day?
solution:
**Formula Used : **

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation : **

v = x/t

⇒ Speed = 2.5x/0.75t 

⇒ 25/10 × 100/75 × x/t

⇒ 250/75 × x/t

By putting v = x/t

⇒ 10v/3

**∴ The correct answer is 10v/3.**
